attributes.action: All zoos should go through an investigatory process to check standards and abuse
attributes.background: Zoos aren’t necessarily it leaves an open experience for children and people with less money to see animals they wouldn’t see otherwise the animals generally should be in a free range zone but checks should be required to ensure animal safety and how the animals are kept
